startedAtNs.description: UTC Unix nanoseconds as decimal string; avoids JavaScript integer precision loss.

x-tools.name: tdev_workspace
x-tools.description: Discover paginated workspaces; inspect a live bounded frontier (including closed resources), open/compose/close exact source. Mixed read/write tool; inspect reports facts, not an automatic plan.

x-tools.name: tdev_read
x-tools.description: Batch bounded immutable file/list/literal-search/diff/history reads at a checkpoint.

x-tools.name: tdev_edit
x-tools.description: Atomically edit files at expected checkpoint. Same request replays before stale checks.

x-tools.name: tdev_exec
x-tools.description: Run commands on Termux by default (same-UID developer authority, not a sandbox); explicit remote executor is optional. Returns a retained operation handle. Never resubmit with a new request after response loss.

x-tools.name: tdev_process
x-tools.description: Observe a retained operation; optional since cursor reports current change/no-change. Control stdin/cancel/retire. Admission ok is not command success: inspect status, effect, result.exitCode and captureError.

x-tools.name: tdev_validate
x-tools.description: Freeze an exact candidate commit and run the operator's mandatory command through trusted outer execution.

x-tools.name: tdev_publish
x-tools.description: Publish exactly the validated commit with expected-old-head CAS. Never revalidate or regenerate source.

x-semantics.oid: Raw full Git OID, repository object format determines length; checkpoint commit is CAS token.
x-semantics.requestId: Principal-scoped installation-lifetime dedup key. Same payload only; current auth precedes replay.

defaults.network: backend default: host for native; none for SSH/OCI

x-semantics.processStatus: Exactly one of operationId and lookupRequestId is required; neither/both rejected.
x-semantics.result: Workspace list/open/edit results, bounded query items, or retained operation. Operation contains id, kind, status, effect, result/error; running is independent of certainty. Output evidence fields are server-owned, never accepted as validation input.

execution.sourceMetadata: Private shallow Git checkpoint; no copied provider credentials. Validation HEAD starts at the frozen candidate commit; native validation rejects changed existing source and never imports test outputs.
execution.nativeBoundary: Same app UID, host network. Clean env and separate HOME/cwd are hygiene, not hostile-code isolation. Native code can access other same-UID files; use only code trusted with ordinary Termux user authority.
execution.nativeLimits: 1 MiB retained output; timeout; per-process CPU, 128 MiB file-size, 256 file-descriptor limits; sampled 128 MiB workspace/home/tmp budget. No hard aggregate memory/PID/disk quota.
execution.nativeRecovery: Detached subreaper supervisor survives controller restart. Lost supervisor after dispatch without a sealed result remains uncertain, never automatically relaunched.

x-semantics.progress: workspace inspect reconciles its busy operation then reads bounded operation page and live remote head. Observation cursor hashes the returned facts, timestamps delimit observation (not atomic cross-provider snapshot). since equal means checked now/no change, not stalled proof; wait at least pollAfterMs or do independent work. Mutation prerequisites are rechecked at admission. Closed workspaces discoverable with includeClosed. Process status since opts into freshness. Replaying a mutation reconciles original identity, never repeats the effect.
x-semantics.annotations: Fixed tmcp host hints: all seven tools set readOnlyHint=true and the other hints=false. Hints do not grant authority; core still enforces mutation identity, authorization, validation and publication.

x-mcp.legacy: Core HTTP: No initialize/initialized, session IDs, GET/DELETE streams, SSE replay or automatic downgrade. No advertised subscriptions, MRTR input requests or task extension.
x-mcp.localCodexAdapter: Explicit optional tdev.codex_bridge stdio endpoint: initialize 2025-11-25, tools/list, tools/call, ping. Fixed localhost HTTP upstream uses 2026-07-28. No retries, execution authority, cancellation effects or durable state. Identical tool schemas, annotations and requestId semantics; not core HTTP version negotiation.
